# SpenDrip

> SpenDrip (https://spendrip.com) is a Nigerian web app for planning your month from payday and automating the payments you plan. You top up one balance and set "drips": recurring payments to yourself or anyone with a Nigerian bank or wallet account, daily, weekly or monthly, at a time you choose (Lagos time). Up to three drips can be ranked priorities, whose money is kept back for the rest of the month so lower drips wait instead of spending it. Plans can start on a date and run for a number of months or until a date. Recipients can get a WhatsApp message when money lands; senders get an email receipt.

Key facts (checked 3 October 2026):
- Joining is free. Each drip costs a ₦50 SpenDrip fee, plus the Paystack transfer fee (₦10 up to ₦5,000; ₦25 up to ₦50,000; ₦50 above) and ₦50 stamp duty on transfers of ₦10,000 and above.
- Top-ups go through Paystack: by card, from a bank account, or by bank transfer.
- Identity check before money moves: a photo of an ID plus three live selfies. New accounts: up to ₦500,000 per transfer and ₦2,000,000 balance.
- Group plans: pay several people together, each with their own amount (staff pay, family support). One ₦100 SpenDrip fee per payout; each transfer keeps its own transfer fee and stamp duty. If the balance can't cover everyone, nobody is paid until it can.
- Finance: see what your take-home pay already commits and what is free to decide, where your money goes by category, what is coming up, and a monthly money report by email on the 1st, with AI-written suggestions (general information, not financial advice). SpenDrip does not read bank accounts or track spending outside the plans and costs a person adds.
- The app is at https://app.spendrip.com.
